checks.name: Import fidelity
checks.principle: Configuration is what the gateway holds, not what was sent

checks.name: Reconciliation
checks.principle: One asset, one tag; the review decision reaches the gateway

checks.name: Binding resolution
checks.principle: A broken binding shows as a quality error on screen

checks.name: Quality honesty
checks.principle: Tag quality carries the truth; no placeholder ever reads Good

checks.name: Liveness
checks.principle: A Good value that never changes is stale

checks.name: Plausibility
checks.principle: Engineering limits belong on the tag; out-of-range is reported, never clipped

checks.name: Read-only enforcement

write_attempts: [default]_verifier/WriteProbe: write accepted (positive control: this client CAN write)

checks.note: Write attempts use a ReadWrite OPC UA user on purpose: a refusal must come from the tags, not from a client that lacked rights. ReviewStatus memory fields are review workflow, not process.
